name: World Spell
description: The spell that warmed the continents, melting glaciers and flooding Terisiare into an archipelago.

description_citations.text: "Terisiare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise, Kristina, Taysir and others cast the World Spell, ending the Ice Age and the Shard.
timeline.quote: ended both the Ice Age and the time of the Shard

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise casts the World Spell to end the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: she cast the World Spell to end the Ice Age.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir and Kristina help Freyalise cast the World Spell, ending the Ice Age and the Shard; the two part ways.
timeline.quote: This ended the Ice Age of Dominaria and ended the time of the Shard.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The World Spell warms the continents, flooding Terisiare into the Terisian Isles.
timeline.quote: When the World Spell warmed the continents, melting the old glaciers, Terisiare was flooded and broke apart into smaller islands.

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "The Flood Ages". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise casts her World Spell, ending the Ice Age and forcing a cold-adapted population to adjust to warm weather.
timeline.quote: After the planeswalker Freyalise cast her World Spell , thereby ending the Ice Age

citation.text: "Alliances", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise speaks the World Spell, and the tamanoa rise to bring a new morning to Terisiare.
timeline.quote: When Freyalise spoke the World Spell, the tamanoa rose to bring a new morning to Terisiare.

citation.text: Tamanoa (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The World Spell thaws the icy graves of the dead, but Heidar calls them to duty.
timeline.quote: But Heidar called them to duty for a twisted cause.

citation.text: Zombie Musher (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Freyalise cast it to end the Ice Age.
